name: Morgan the Collector
summary: At the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Morgan the Collector directs Defias extortion and gathering across Elwynn Forest. A high-ranking operative, he coordinates local theft from the farmhouse while Goldshire's guard keeps watch nearby.

sections.title: The Tithe of Elwynn
sections.body: Morgan the Collector skims gold from Elwynn Forest's mines for the Defias Brotherhood. While common bandits harass travelers on the roads, he directs organized shakedowns and gathers stolen coin and supplies for the Brotherhood's wider network. His headquarters is the farmhouse at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where loyal enforcers including Surena Caledon and Erlan Drudgemoor surround him.

sections.title: A Signet of the Past
sections.body: Morgan carries a distinctive signet ring that marks his authority. Investigators in Goldshire see the ring as evidence connecting the masked thieves terrorizing the heartland to the disgraced Stonemasons Guild, which rebuilt Stormwind City after the Second War. Recovering the ring reveals who directs the bandits in the woods.

faq.answer: Morgan is a high-ranking officer in the Defias Brotherhood who collects gold taken from Elwynn Forest's mines and coordinates bandit activity in the region.
Morgan keeps his stolen goods in the farmhouse at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest.
Marshal Dughan and local authorities want Morgan eliminated to sever Defias leadership in Elwynn and recover proof of who organizes the rural uprisings.

faq.q: What is special about the ring he carries?
faq.answer: Morgan carries a signet ring that gives authorities evidence as they investigate his activities in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can see how Morgan's discipline turns scattered thieves into an organized underground syndicate that funds an insurgency.
As a Human, taking down Morgan strikes back at the traitors who have turned Stormwind's peaceful farms into fortified bandit dens.
